title: Design: A/R Collection call list on the customer row looks as described
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has an overdue invoice, a phone number and a credit term; customer {Customer-B} has an overdue invoice and no phone.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-43 Phone Row with phone (403) 555-0103 and credit term Net 30; {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST D-43 No Phone Row.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Collection is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Read {Customer-A}'s group row, letter for letter.
  2. Read {Customer-B}'s group row.
  3. Look for overlap or clipping on both rows, in light and dark theme.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the name, then "Phone: " and the number, then "Credit term: " and the term, on the group row after the name.
  • Step 2: the name and "Credit term: COD" (if none set); no "Phone:" label.
  • Step 3: nothing overlaps or is clipped, in either theme.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11539 (Story 9, A/R Collection call list)

  • S9-R1: “On A/R Collection, each customer's group row shows, after the customer's name, "Phone: " and the customer's phone number as the customer card shows it.”
  • S9-R2: “For users with the 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' switch, the group row also shows "Credit term: " and the customer's credit term as the customer card shows it ("COD" when none is set).”
  • S9-N1: “A customer with no phone shows no "Phone:" label, on screen or in the PDF.”
